attrs.description: Review an architecture or design for trade-offs, failure modes, and security exposure.
Parse, validate, and profile a raw dataset into a structured, described shape.
Ingest and structure raw evidence (notes, documents, signals) into a normalized summary.
Draft a decision or status memo from a problem statement and context.
Draft a product requirements document from a problem statement and supporting evidence.
Review a proposal for correctness, risk, and hidden assumptions before acceptance.
Synthesize multiple sources into a cited, evidence-graded research summary.
Stress-test a plan for risk: failure modes, security, and compliance exposure.
Structure an unclassified brain-dump or rough notes into a normalized summary with extracted intents.
Process a meeting/call transcript into a summary, decisions, and action items.
Classify and route unstructured input to the appropriate workflow.
